title: Design System: Prospero — Spaces video workspace

nodeLibraryR19.forwardCompatibility: Require media type and declared starter inputs; start/prompt shared, motion/audio/end exclusive; retain references and undo.
nodeLibraryR19.portLabels: Light .sp-node labels use text-2, #4a3f55 on #efe9f3, 8.26:1; handles, cables and dark text retain colors.
nodeLibraryR19.review: r18-finish-review.txt FIX F1; r19-finish-verdict.txt RESOLVED/scoped SHIP; independent code CAS19 APPROVE.
nodeLibraryR19.limits: Historical captures retain original scope; exclude wrongly framed r19-ports-light.png. Order rows are below crop; source and native receipts establish behavior. No artistic, exact-comp, whole-product or comprehensive accessibility approval. No shipping raster assets. Historical metadata preserved.

scope.visualAuthority: Existing graph editor and pinned dragon, plum and magenta identity; local extension

surfaceBrief.audience: Users creating and revising audiovisual work in Prospero's local node editor.
surfaceBrief.job: Resume or start a connected video canvas, generate clips and inspect or revise them inline.
surfaceBrief.direction: Preserve the mature @xyflow editor, shared typography and theme tokens, typed ports and existing tool access.
surfaceBrief.firstViewport: Saved canvas or a Media to Clip starter, with direct source choice, prompt and node-level generation.
surfaceBrief.signatureInteraction: Generate and compare a clip in its connected node without leaving the canvas.
constraints: Continue from last frame adds and focuses a wired successor for one included video output, without starting a render; action row wraps and one undo removes node plus wire.
No compulsory document, wizard or production review for direct clip generation.
Keep all existing node types, branches, continuation, Combine, templates, Apps and save/recovery tools.
Preserve user positions and original media.
Keep model readiness distinct from job success and output quality.
Keep full output frames visible and focused mobile nodes usable through vertical panning.

geometry.videoMonitor: width: 100%; max-height: 280px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 6px
geometry.mobileFocus: Intersect canvas bounds with visible window width; reserve 48px and include width + 8px for handles/outline; fit by width and allow vertical panning.
geometry.tokenStatus: Local surface geometry; not new global design tokens.

breakpoints.name: canvas-width-focus
breakpoints.purpose: Canvas width threshold for width-based node focus.

breakpoints.name: workspace-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Wrap toolbar and hide secondary module/vitals regions in the workspace shell.

behavior.nodeLibrary: 28 shortcuts over all16 native types, including Extract frame; grouped by function; Spanish/English accent-insensitive search. Docked286px at widths1100px and above, overlay below with close on pick. The nodeLibraryR19 entry retains the earlier pass's evidence and attribution.
behavior.wiredStarters: Motion, lip sync and first/last starters add native asset inputs and wires in one undo group, focus the video and never render automatically. Incoming wire replaces the corresponding empty input.
behavior.assemblyOrder: Combine lists incoming clip wires in execution order with up/down; each wire contributes included takes. Existing history/save and native MCP disconnect/connect preserve the ordering.
behavior.ltxRefinement: Optional image-only LTX checkbox before status/text; off by default, doubles output dimensions with native refinement. Availability checks the upscaler independently. Desktop/mobile390 and reload persistence in research-inbox/prospero-quality1190/r14-refine-* and r14-ui-persistence.json; demo does not prove output quality.
behavior.entry: Resume remembered project canvas, then existing canvas; create quick_video only when none exists. A library image opens a new referenced graph.
behavior.sourceConversion: Convert source to image generator and preserve existing images in a connected upstream reference node.
behavior.engineCatalog: Exact workflow nodes and model-file choices determine live availability. Cached inventory remains offline. Auto chooses available Wan 14B then Wan 5B.
behavior.ltxModels: Explicit LTX2.3 distilled image-to-video and motion-wired Union Control IC-LoRA. Motion selector preserves Animate2; guide offset/action/strength stay in the node. Hide the inapplicable reference-strength knob and Wan four-step checkbox; no new page or review gate.
behavior.output: Native inline playback, download, enlargement, saved runs and selected takes; previous-run comparison appears below the current output at matching output position.
behavior.regeneration: Existing node-level generation and run scopes remain available.
behavior.videoControlOrder: After existing output playback, show model, duration, guide offset, engine status and applicable strengths before the appearance/action texts. Keep the strength hint adjacent, and retain all conditions, values and callbacks. Demo desktop/intermediate/mobile captures and save/reload receipt: research-inbox/prospero-quality1190/layout-r13-*; scoped finish ship, not model-quality approval.
behavior.productionReview: New music-video productions continue by default; explicit song/animatic review remains optional.

openedCaptures.state: Replaced F1 capture showing both port edges and selection outline

evidence.backend: Declared demo backend in all captures; layout and interaction evidence only.

review.scope: F1 correction; original review exclusions retained

evidence.documenterVerification: Source inspection and all three final screenshots opened; no test rerun or live app operation.

limits: Dark-theme screenshots only for this pass; inherited light-theme support was not independently captured here.
Tall-node lower controls require vertical panning and are not all visible in the mobile viewport.
Static evidence does not establish job transitions, comprehensive accessibility or real model quality.
Historical continuation measurements belong to their original pass.
Separate Studio composition gates and root metadata remain unchanged; no exact-comp or whole-product approval.

frameExtractionR22.scope: Local frame extraction extension R20–R22 within the inherited graph editor.
frameExtractionR22.nodeLibrary: Current:28 shortcuts over16 native types; earlier R18/R19 counts retain their historical scope.

geometry.mobile: Existing Focus retains readable width and both port edges; lower image output continues through vertical panning.
geometry.tokenStatus: Local surface geometry; no new global tokens.

behavior.entry: Extract frame in Transform, native frame node with at_s default0.
behavior.ports: Many video inputs on clip; image output on out.
behavior.source: Native source player previews the first resolved connected clip; a missing clip shows a connection instruction.
behavior.time: Labelled seconds input, min0 and step any; source seeks to valid edited time on change/metadata. Use playhead time pauses and retains numeric precision; ended playback selects the adjacent double below duration.
behavior.action: Extract remains in the ordinary node action row; hint explains one image per clip at the same second without a model.
behavior.output: Image result follows picker in the same card and can feed references or a video's start.

openedCaptures.state: Light theme; Done frame node at1.2 seconds; typed connections and lower image result.
Same completed node in inherited dark theme.
Dark theme; both edges/ports, source and time controls visible; lower output continues below viewport.

evidence.backend: Demo backend explicitly visible; displayed source/output use a real task1190 take without artistic approval.
evidence.review: r22-finish-review.txt:ship for scoped Operate extension, no material visual fix; historical Studio gates remain open.
evidence.documenterVerification: Source inspection and all three supplied captures opened; no own tests, MCP or live app operation.

limits: Historical1167/R18/R19 evidence keeps its original scope and attribution.
Static captures do not certify extraction accuracy, all dynamic states, keyboard focus or comprehensive accessibility.
Mobile lower output requires the intended vertical pan.
No shipping raster assets, artistic approval, exact-comp approval, root gate closure or whole-product approval; task1190 remains artistically open.

narrative.overview: Create, inspect and revise video in the existing connected canvas, using Prospero's inherited working surfaces and pinned identity.
dos: Do keep generation, preview and result actions in the node.
Do contain full media frames and wrap result actions.
Do focus mobile nodes by visible width with room for ports and selection outline.
donts: Don't replace the existing graph editor or pinned dragon-and-magenta identity.
Don't make the quick-video starter a compulsory workflow.
Don't infer model quality or exact-comp approval from demo captures.
